mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO token_usage_records ( session_id, user_id, model_name, input_tokens, output_tokens, total_tokens, request_time, response_time, processing_time, success, error_message ) VALUES
( #{item.sessionId}, #{item.userId}, #{item.modelName}, #{item.inputTokens}, #{item.outputTokens}, #{item.totalTokens}, #{item.requestTime}, #{item.responseTime}, #{item.processingTime}, #{item.success}, #{item.errorMessage} )
mapper.select: SELECT DATE(created_at) as date, SUM(input_tokens) as totalInputTokens, SUM(output_tokens) as totalOutputTokens, SUM(total_tokens) as totalTokens, COUNT(*) as requestCount FROM token_usage_records WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND created_at BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY date

SELECT model_name as modelName, SUM(total_tokens) as totalTokens, COUNT(*) as requestCount, AVG(processing_time) as avgProcessingTime FROM token_usage_records WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND created_at BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY model_name ORDER BY totalTokens DESC
